main_findings: B3a peak~eps^(p-2), width~eps, central mass~eps^(p-1) for r=1,2; p=1 normalized total mass ->2.
For an exactly linear crossing, r=1 and r=2 have incompatible pointwise initial zero velocities as eps->0; this is a nonuniform t=0 singular limit.
Large-domain tests show the transverse zero remains transverse on the clean observed horizon; the apparent early reversal/cusp in L=2 after t~0.015 was outer-scale contamination.
At fixed t=0.01 in L=8, D12 tends to zero for p=1 and p=1.5.
